note: Microsoft BASIC for 6502 (V1.1), the MIT-licensed release of Microsoft's original 1978 6502 BASIC, assembled with ca65 into a 32 KB ROM at $8000 (reset/IRQ/NMI vectors at $FFFA). It boots on the eater6502 machine (RAM $0000-$3FFF, ROM $8000-$FFFF, 65C51 ACIA console at $5000) to the MICROSOFT BASIC V1.1 banner and the OK prompt over the ACIA serial console. Packaged as media-lab project projects/ms-basic-6502 (fetch.sh reproduces this byte-for-byte from the pinned buildable source).

historical.role: original macro source (reference only; not assemblable by modern tools)
